scale.meaning: 0 absent or unusable; 4 meets the P0 target

dimensions.description: The prompt creates a Director card and a whitebox scene without an infrastructure error.
The scene, object, action, camera, timing, and aspect match the prompt and expected card.

anchors.2: Main subject matches but one required element is missing
anchors.4: All required elements are visible and correctly interpreted

dimensions.description: The whitebox can be played and exposes the expected shot strip/timeline and camera path.

anchors.0: Cannot play or no playable content
anchors.2: Playback starts but a required surface is missing
anchors.4: Play, shot strip/timeline, camera motion, and preview all complete

dimensions.description: A local edit changes the requested target while preserving unrelated scene, timing, and camera state.

anchors.0: Edit is global, wrong, or unrecoverable
anchors.2: Target changes but collateral drift is visible
anchors.4: Only the requested target changes and the result replays

dimensions.description: The user reaches the first inspectable preview with the expected controls and reasonable effort.

anchors.0: No preview or repeated unexplained retries
anchors.2: Preview requires workaround or more than 120 seconds
anchors.4: First preview in 60 seconds or less with no workaround

dimensions.description: A failed generation or local edit exposes a clear recovery path and rollback preserves the last good state.

anchors.0: Failure loses work or has no recovery
anchors.2: Recovery exists but is ambiguous or incomplete
anchors.4: Failure is explicit, retry/undo restores the last good state
